values: Complete the Instance sheet. Instance alias and AWS region are required.
Add one row per routing skill. Skill names must be unique.
Add agents and reference a Skill name exactly as entered on the Skills sheet.
Add contact flows. The welcome message becomes the initial generated flow.
Add DNIS rows and reference a ContactFlow name exactly.
Do not include API keys, AWS credentials, passwords, or customer data.
Save the workbook, upload it to ConnectCraft, and generate the Terraform package.
